title: slavic Jayce Giopara
alt: A scan of a physical piece of art: a marker drawing of a character against a solid white background, full-body. The character is holding a giant axe-hammer made out of pipes and scrap, with the handle specifically being a pipe. He is dressed in traditionally slavic clothing: white shirt with a black vest, yellow pants with green vertical stripes, black knee-high boots and a red sash. All of it is decorated with flowers, including the weapon being covered in red flowers.
caption: beginnings of my obsession with slavicizing characters, 2020

title: Rosół
alt: A scan of a physical piece of art: a black ink lineart print against a yellow rectangle, on solid white background. The print is of ingredients for the Polish soup known as 'rosół', from left to right: a carrot, cabbage, celeriac, coriander, bay leaf, chicken thigh, leek.
caption: title is the Polish name of a specific chicken noodle soup, 2020; bought the physical print

title: Pride frog avatar
alt: Digital image of a semi-realistic frog against a background of horizontal stripess in the colors of asexual flag (black, grey, white, purple). The frog is light green and has its tongue out playfully. It is wearing a bead necklace in the colors of the non-binary flag (yellow, white, purple, black).
caption: used by me widely as an avatar, 2021

title: Saint Laika of one-way trips
alt: A scan of a physical piece of art: a watercolor and mixed media painting. The painting portrays the constellation Canis Major (the Dog) outlined in bright, glowing blue with the form of a dog. The dog has a golden sun/star disc behind its head, forming a holy halo, and rays of light coming are down from it. The dog is floating, headed right. The background is dark and covered in blue and white dots, as well as glitter, to portray a starry sky and the starry cosmos. Above and below the dog figure there is golden text in cyrylics-stylised font, saying in Polish 'Święta Łajka / od podróży bez powrotu', which means literally 'Saint Laika of trips with no return'.
caption: text on the picture means the same as the title, 2026; bought the physical painting
